Today most image generation uses [[ia-difusion|diffusion]], which is far more stable to train, but the idea of the learned loss has stayed: a discriminator is still used as part of the loss in video compression, in superresolution and in speech synthesis, where saying by hand in what way two signals are alike is just as hard as with images.

The idea of 2014 was to remove the formula and put in a second network that learns to judge.
